entries.title: A maximized card keeps its buttons inside the window
entries.body: When a card's words were only a little too long for a maximized card, its bottom edge and its buttons could sit below the window, out of reach. A maximized card now always fits inside the window, with its buttons in view.

picture.alt: A maximized decision card fills the window with its reply field and its Decline, Save for later and Approve buttons in view at the bottom
